diagnosis.symptom: User-reported width problem on the 360° research brief.
diagnosis.root_cause: The .article container was bound to --col-read (720px). The 12-vendor competitor matrix (.compmat) was a child of that container and attempted horizontal scroll within a 720px viewport — making the 4-column table (14rem + 10rem + 10rem + prose column) effectively unreadable. The prose column was squeezed to ~100–150px. Confirmed visually via headless Chrome screenshot before fixing.
diagnosis.secondary_finding: The file's --col-read token was 720px, 40px narrower than both peer artifacts (cairn/architecture.html and engineering/people-graph-substrate.html, which both use min(760px, 92vw)). Neither col-read-wide nor col-mid were in use despite --col-mid being defined in :root.

fix.approach: Three surgical CSS-only changes. No structural HTML edits. No !important.

changes.why: Peer parity with cairn/architecture.html and engineering/people-graph-substrate.html. 40px wider on prose improves density without crossing the ~80ch line-length ceiling for body text.
Matches peer artifact pattern; available for future use (e.g., wide callouts, dense lists). Not yet applied to any element in this file — introduced for completeness of the token set.

changes.what: Broke .compmat out to --col-mid (1080px) using negative-margin breakout pattern
changes.why: The 12-vendor matrix table requires ~1080px to give the Eglin's read prose column comfortable reading space alongside three fixed-width columns totaling ~34rem. The breakout uses: width: var(--col-mid); margin-left: calc((var(--col-read) - var(--col-mid)) / 2); margin-right: calc((var(--col-read) - var(--col-mid)) / 2). At narrow viewports where both tokens resolve to 92vw, the calc approaches zero automatically — no overflow. Mobile reset (max-width: 760px) and print reset both added to prevent breakout in those contexts.

validation.visual: Headless Chrome screenshots at 1440px. Before: matrix table crushed to ~360px effective width, 'Eglin's read' column ~100px. After: matrix renders at 1080px, all four columns legible, prose column ~480px. Body prose column unchanged — correct line length maintained.
validation.mobile: .compmat reset to width: 100%; margin-left: 0; margin-right: 0 at max-width: 760px. overflow-x: auto preserved for narrow viewports where the table exceeds screen width.
validation.print: print media query updated: .compmat { width: 100%; margin-left: 0; margin-right: 0; } to prevent break-out on paper.

body.accessibility_o1: No contrast changes. No typography changes. No structural HTML changes. The wider matrix actually improves readability for low-vision users who use browser zoom — the prose column no longer collapses to an illegible strip at 1× zoom. No regression introduced.
